clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: Anthropic拟60亿美元收购AI初创Decart
title_lines: 瞄准世界模型与芯片优化技术

subtitles.en: Yeah, this is a startup called D-Cart and is really startup that does two things.
subtitles.zh: 是的，这是一家名为D-Cart的初创公司，它主要做两件事。

subtitles.en: They work on world models, world models, literally AI models that try to understand the world, more rooted in real world physics.
subtitles.zh: 他们研究世界模型，即试图理解世界的AI模型，更贴近现实世界的物理规律。

subtitles.en: They're trained on things like video data, it's beyond text.
subtitles.zh: 他们用视频数据等训练模型，超越了文本范畴。

subtitles.en: But the second thing that they do is have a software platform that makes chips better at running AI, you know, optimizing basically.
subtitles.zh: 其次，他们有一个软件平台，能让芯片更高效地运行AI，本质上就是优化。

subtitles.en: And it seems like based on our reporting, that's the bit anthropics interested in.
subtitles.zh: 根据我们的报道，Anthropic感兴趣的正是这一点。

subtitles.en: So it's a $6 billion deal, we're reporting, citing sources, we don't know the structure of the deal.
subtitles.zh: 这是一笔60亿美元的交易，我们根据消息来源报道，但交易结构尚不清楚。

subtitles.en: But in the context of what you just said, it would be inthropic's biggest acquisition to date.
subtitles.zh: 但结合你刚才提到的，这将是Anthropic迄今最大的一笔收购。

subtitles.en: And with an IPO right around the corner, it's interesting timing, but it kind of speaks to the operational technical challenges that anthropics still has.
subtitles.zh: 而且IPO在即，时机很微妙，但这反映出Anthropic在运营和技术上仍面临挑战。

subtitles.en: Is this out of the ordinary, though, for anthropic though, because they really make these big acquisitions?
subtitles.zh: 不过，这对Anthropic来说是否不同寻常？因为他们确实进行过大规模收购。

subtitles.en: This is a big one, I mean, but they've been really spending heavily, you know, computing power.
subtitles.zh: 这是一笔大交易，而且他们在计算能力上投入巨大。

subtitles.en: They want to develop new products. Yeah, I don't know, $6 billion doesn't seem very big to me when you think about the balance sheet.
subtitles.zh: 他们想开发新产品。嗯，我不确定，但考虑到资产负债表，60亿美元对我来说并不算多。

subtitles.en: I mean, the way that I look at it is anthropics raised even this year, you know, north of $100 billion.
subtitles.zh: 我的看法是，Anthropic今年甚至筹集了超过1000亿美元。

subtitles.en: And most of that sits on its balance sheet, you know, and even the money it raised prior to this year probably still sits on its balance sheet.
subtitles.zh: 而且大部分资金都留在其资产负债表上，甚至今年之前筹集的资金可能也还在。

大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
